summary: Narrow top bar section above header with links, language selector, and mode switch.
shortDescription: The Top Bar Studio section creates a slim utility strip positioned above the main header. It provides space for secondary navigation links such as store locator or contact pages, along with optional language selection and color mode toggle. Available in Grey or Black styles, the top bar keeps utility features accessible without cluttering the primary header navigation.
